request.prompt:
Create a dedicated MYTHIC boss animation source sheet for exactly the supplied character, preserving its unique costume/materials/anatomy. A unique towering dark knight commander, closed angular blue-steel helmet with a tall swept-back double crest, huge layered asymmetrical steel pauldrons, dark articulated armor with cold silver filigree, pale ash-blue torn cape, broad rectangular greatsword with a blue gemstone pommel in anatomical RIGHT hand, LEFT gauntlet empty. Heavy armored boots; distinctive tall crest, never Kurtz red cape or horn helmet.
Fixed camera throughout this sheet: NORTHEAST REAR three-quarter facing UP-RIGHT. Show back and right side. Anatomical RIGHT weapon arm is near/screenRIGHT, LEFT empty hand far/screenLEFT.
Action RUN: Six clear locomotion poses in order: phase0 RIGHT leg contact, phase1 RIGHT leg compresses/LEFT free leg swings, phase2 RIGHT toeoff/LEFT knee drives, phase3 LEFT leg contact/RIGHT leg lifts, phase4 LEFT leg compresses/RIGHT free leg swings, phase5 LEFT toeoff/RIGHT knee drives. Clearly alternate anatomical support legs between0 and3. Planted sole LOWEST, lifted sole above it. Heavy grounded advance, not six copies of one crouch. For horse use a natural four-leg canter sequence, for spider alternating supported leg groups, for floating reaper rhythmic hovering robe propulsion without fake legs.
CORRECTION: The FIRST reference establishes identity ONLY and may face the wrong side. The SECOND reference establishes a reviewed same-character camera direction. Adopt the required camera below consistently for ALL SIX poses; never copy the first reference camera automatically.
BACK RIGHT three-quarter: BACK of head, cape and shoulders dominate; no front breastplate/bodice or frontal face. Never front-right.
Exactly ONE anatomical RIGHT-held weapon throughout if the character uses one; never hand swap or duplicate. Left hand stays free. Natural head recoil is fine without changing the overall facing.
Layout EXACTLY SIX COMPLETE distinct animation poses in TWO COLUMNS and THREE ROWS (2x3), read row-major 0,1 / 2,3 / 4,5, WIDE LANDSCAPE transparent canvas. Keep each figure body about200px high with identical scale. Each full silhouette including extended wings, scythe, axe, staff, sword, tail and cape must fit comfortably inside its own large cell with generous empty alpha gutters and outside margins. No pose or weapon intersects another; no anatomy reaches canvas edge. No floor/shadow/effects/text. Preserve character identity and action sequence. Not flipped, no mirrored anatomy.
